title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36641v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments a

translated_title: 从仅结果奖励的强化学习中诱导过程监督
translated_abstract: 过程奖励模型（PRM）已成为大语言模型（LLM）的关键组件，其步骤级反馈既能支持后训练阶段，也能支持测试时的推理。然而，训练强大的PRM成本依然高昂：人工步骤标注难以规模化，而蒙特卡洛估计计算代价昂贵，且可能偏离步骤本身的内在正确性。为了以低成本获得有效的PRM，我们提出了TIPS（Thinking-Induced Process Supervision，思维诱导过程监督），这是一个仅使用结果奖励的强化学习（RL）框架，用于训练生成式PRM。在TIPS中，模型先生成一条思维链（CoT），随后给出步骤级标签和结果标签。奖励仅取决于预测的结果是否与真实结果相符，由此产生的组相对优势被用于优化整个生成的响应。直观地说，当检查中间步骤有助于判定结果时，更准确的步骤检查能够带来更好的结果判断……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TIPS框架，仅依靠结果对错的强化学习信号即可训练生成式过程奖励模型，使模型在生成思维链的过程中自发学会步骤级监督，从而大幅降低PRM的训练成本。
